descriptions.notStarted: #b#@1072008:##k in #bNautilus#k says it is now time to defeat #rCrocell#k. Let's go find her.
descriptions.inProgress: If you go to #b#m100030000##k, you will find the Dark Portal where #rCrocell#k is hiding. You can enter using #rCrocell's Emblem#k. Defeat #rCrocell#k!\n\nReport back to #b#@1072008:##k in #bNautilus#k upon completion.
descriptions.completed: Although you have defeated #rCrocell#k, whose seal had been broken, who or what is responsible for the broken seal still remains a mystery.
